announcements_expiry_check.name: announcements_expiry_check
announcements_expiry_check.value: "announcements"."expires_at" is null or "announcements"."published_at" is null or "announcements"."expires_at" > "announcements"."published_at"

announcements_scope_identity_check.name: announcements_scope_identity_check
announcements_scope_identity_check.value:
(
        ("announcements"."scope" = 'PLATFORM' and "announcements"."creator_id" is null)
        or ("announcements"."scope" = 'CREATOR' and "announcements"."creator_id" is not null)
      )

shipments_tracking_identity_check.name: shipments_tracking_identity_check
shipments_tracking_identity_check.value: length("shipments"."carrier_code") between 1 and 80 and length("shipments"."tracking_number") between 1 and 160
